season.evidence: A club route listing gives June-September; stored Jul-Sep, best August. Logged ascents 52 in July and 35 in August.

track.why: Only route stored on the peak; 2025-08-23 summited round trip from Holden (starts 128 m from our pin), climbs the Copper Creek basin to the south-east snow then the ridge, and the report says it avoids the fourth-class step by joining the ridge higher.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Track wanders far south of the peak toward another summit; not a clean line
Does not meet the round-trip rule (ends 1.4 km from pin)
Track also continues far north-west to another peak (link-up)

facts.text: By late August the route is free of snow and ice, and parties have climbed it without an axe or crampons.
In mid-July a snow ramp between slabs on the southeast face leads above 7,600 ft and needs an axe and crampons.
Aim for the cairned notch on the east ridge; going too high on the snow forces a descending traverse back to it.
Joining the ridge higher up skips the fourth-class step.
Late June: the last scramble from the final snow patch to the ridge is exposed Class 3; downclimbing to skier's right is closer to Class 4.
The high camp near 6,500 ft has running water beside it and flat room for about one two-person tent (late August).

notes: Holden Village access has had closures from storm damage and fire; owner may want to check before surfacing.
